evals.name: freihand-dataset-full-dive
evals.prompt: 我对 3D 手部建模完全陌生。请帮我吃透附件中的 FreiHAND 论文。先用 30 秒结论和五分钟白话故事，让我真正理解问题、关键思路、数据怎么造出来、为什么实验值得相信；然后解释作者与实验室的哪些积累促成了这篇工作，列出最相关的前后论文和官方 GitHub；再把精确方法、指标、复现和来源放进可选附录。优先使用原论文图表，也可以补充一张明确标注的 AI 教学示意图。不要让审稿术语、证据编号或夸张表达挡住理解。
evals.expected_output: A three-layer deep dive for an unfamiliar reader: a 30-second mental model, a self-contained plain-language walkthrough, and an optional evidence-backed technical appendix.
files: /Users/wayne/Downloads/FreiHAND- A Dataset for Markerless Capture of Hand Pose and Shape from Single RGB Images.pdf
expectations: Identifies the exact paper/version and uses full-paper evidence for method, figure, and experiment claims.
The first screen states the difficulty, key move, and bounded consequence in language an unfamiliar reader can repeat.
Publishes a self-contained five-minute walkthrough followed by an optional technical appendix; understanding does not depend on reading the appendix.
Uses one concrete running sample, introduces terms only after explaining them, and avoids invented author motives or theatrical/adversarial wording.
Keeps Claim IDs, evidence-class labels, commit hashes, reviewer jargon, and source-line details out of the teaching layer.
Explains decisive metrics in plain language; records exact AUC/PCK/F-score/alignment protocol in the appendix and marks the Table 1 AUC interval unknown if unverified.
Separates acquisition, annotation/fitting, training, inference, and evaluation; the table says whether a stage runs at deployment rather than whether its artifact is later used.
Analyzes and embeds legible crops for load-bearing visuals, including Table 1's missing HO-3D cell and training-split substitution from its caption.

Uses inspected paper figures for factual apparatus/results and, if a generated conceptual image is included, labels it as an AI teaching illustration rather than a paper figure or experimental result.
Reports the paper's 15-minute full-keypoint, 12-second mask-correction, 2-second keypoint, and 5-second validation timings without converting them into an unsupported total-cost claim.
Provides three concise reusable principles and a two-sentence retelling before the appendix.
Explains the Freiburg and Adobe capability lines after the method is understood, using first-party author/lab sources without inferring individual module ownership.
Links the official lab organization, FreiHAND repository, direct predecessor/follow-up repositories, and states what each contains versus which production components remain unreleased.
Uses a branching technical tree with an older root and work near the analysis-year cutoff, separates two reproduction targets, and places commit-pinned code facts in the appendix only.

evals.name: reviewer-experiment-audit
evals.prompt: 请对附件中的 FreiHAND 使用 reviewer mode。重点审查数据集泛化、迭代标注和形状标签三类主张是否被实验支撑，baseline 和 ablation 是否公平，有没有隐藏假设、替代解释和最该补的实验。不要复述 abstract。
evals.expected_output: A claim-to-evidence audit that distinguishes author claims from the analyst's judgment and proposes concrete missing experiments.
files: /Users/wayne/Downloads/FreiHAND- A Dataset for Markerless Capture of Hand Pose and Shape from Single RGB Images.pdf
expectations: Builds an explicit claim-to-evidence mapping rather than summarizing the abstract.

May use globally unique Claim IDs because reviewer mode was explicitly requested, and examines baseline fairness, the HO-3D split exception, ablation isolation, metric semantics, confounders, and failure cases.
Separates actual public reviews, if available, from independent reviewer analysis and labels inaccessible evidence.
Proposes at least one discriminating missing experiment tied to a specific alternative explanation.

evals.name: implementation-focused-reproduction
evals.prompt: 我想使用并尽可能复现附件中的 FreiHAND。请分开说明怎样使用已发布数据/评测，以及怎样复现八相机采集与标注生产线；从论文、supplement 和官方代码还原数据流、关键配置、成本、最小里程碑和工程诊断。论文没说的地方不要猜成事实。
evals.expected_output: An evidence-aware reproduction blueprint separating paper specification, official-code behavior, estimates, and recommended engineering practice.
files: /Users/wayne/Downloads/FreiHAND- A Dataset for Markerless Capture of Hand Pose and Shape from Single RGB Images.pdf
expectations: Separates paper-stated behavior, official-code behavior, analyst estimates, and recommendations.

Covers data, coordinate frames, fitting weights, iteration schedule, acceptance rules, human timings, component interfaces, training/optimization, inference, dependencies, license, and access constraints.
Pins official repository behavior to a commit and explicitly lists unreleased or unspecified production-pipeline fields.
Provides a staged minimal reproduction with sanity checks and failure diagnostics.
Any runtime, GPU, memory, or storage estimate includes a source or explicit assumptions and uncertainty.
